disease_state.evidence: Here, we performed label-free liquid chromatography coupled to tandem MS (LC-MS/MS) to profile the normal human proteome.

material_type.evidence: Fresh frozen human tissue sections collected at autopsy were cut and weighed (~150 mg wet weight).
We considered data from seven biological fluids, including urine, cerebrospinal fluid, synovial fluid, seminal plasma, sweat, cervical vaginal fluid, and nipple aspirate fluid.

sample_source.evidence: In total, we analyzed 117 samples from 46 normal tissues and organs at autopsy.
